answer: Shards are assigned from the sparrow graph, as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The willow assignment is published and voyage records each panel. The grading quorum of 8 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 3356 identities would post 4668 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
